story: I placed a prepaid order on Amazon on September 26, 2024 for a Wakefit orthopedic mattress. The listed price was ₹9,799 but I paid ₹8,819.10 after a bank discount, using my Visa card online. The shipment was not delivered on time, so I contacted Delhivery, the delivery partner, and they suggested cancelling the order through an OTP. The order was cancelled on October 7, 2024. Tracking shows the mattress went back to the seller and reached Faridabad on October 16, 2024. Amazon told me the refund would be processed, but the app shows a total expected refund of ₹0.00 and nothing has been credited, even after repeated emails and phone calls.

expected.rationale: Refund pending (not received), exact cancellation date, support contacted by email and phone, grievance officer not mentioned.

story: On October 5, 2025 I ordered a 5-gram 24K gold coin on Myntra for ₹59,750, paid by UPI, plus a ₹20 platform fee. The expected delivery date was October 22, 2025. The coin never arrived. I contacted Myntra again and again by email, WhatsApp and its support channels and kept asking for delivery. On November 15, 2025 Myntra cancelled the order itself and refunded ₹59,730, which reached my account the same day. Gold prices went up in the meantime, so I can no longer buy the same coin at that price. What can I do?

expected.rationale: The refund was credited, so the refund is not pending or unresolved; no rule from R3-R6 applies.

story: On 23rd November 2021 we ordered 30 mosquito and bird nets from Amazon and paid Rs. 17,970 in advance with a Bajaj EMI card. Only one of the 30 items arrived. We cancelled the whole order through Amazon on 29th November 2021 and returned the one item, as Amazon instructed, on 8th December 2021. We sent notices to Amazon and to the seller, Shiv Enterprises, but no refund has come. Meanwhile three EMIs have already been deducted from my bank account.

expected.rationale: Refund not received, exact cancellation date, notices sent to the platform and seller (contact made), grievance officer not mentioned.

story: I ordered a riding jacket for Rs. 7350 and a mosquito mesh for Rs. 799 on Amazon. I was not happy with them and asked to return both. The pickup agent first marked the items as not ready without calling me, and customer service rescheduled the pickup for three days later. The jacket was then marked as picked up but the mesh was not. After I kept calling customer care, they told me that when the parcel reached their hub it had a mosquito mesh in it instead of the jacket. They promised the refund by August 16th, then said there would be an update by August 19th, and on August 19th they told me the refund was cancelled because the wrong item was sent.

expected.rationale: No exact purchase, cancellation or return date (the August dates have no year).

story: I bought a Casio analogue men's watch worth Rs. 2,995 on Flipkart on October 14, 2021. After it was shipped I got a message that the order was cancelled because of a product price error. I placed the same order a second time; that was also cancelled and I was told a refund would be processed. I complained on the National Consumer Helpline. Flipkart then placed a new order itself, showing an amount of Rs 15,000, but I never received it, and my original payment has not been refunded.

expected.rationale: Refund pending with an exact purchase date, and the story does not state that the platform's support was contacted. Rule outcome; the National Consumer Helpline complaint is not a modelled fact.

story: On July 20, 2022 I ordered Adidas Runstunner running shoes on the Flipkart app. They were listed at a discounted price of Rs 975, down from Rs 4,999. The very next day Flipkart cancelled my order without any valid reason and without my consent. I tried Flipkart's customer care to ask why and to get the seller's details, but they did not help and would not address the cancellation. I then went to the National Consumer Helpline.

expected.rationale: The refund status is not stated (no payment or refund is described).

story: I ordered a sound bar with a sub-woofer from the seller Appario Retail through Amazon, using a friend's credit card. It was delivered on 15/07/2023 and installed five days later. The sound clarity was poor, so I returned it. It was collected on 24/07/2023 and I was assured the refund would come within five days. Two weeks went by with no refund. When I contacted Amazon customer service, they told me the product had not been received back.

expected.rationale: Refund pending, exact pickup date, the merchant's own 5-day promise has passed (R4 does not apply), support contacted, grievance officer not mentioned.

story: I ordered a Toshiba 1 TB external hard disk on Flipkart and paid INR 3,907 using the EMI option on my Citi Bank credit card. It was never shipped or delivered. Flipkart customer care confirmed by email that the seller, MPDSLE Retail, cancelled the order because of extended delivery delays. I tried many times through chats and calls to sort it out, and I could not cancel the order myself because of a portal error. No refund of INR 3,907 has been issued.

expected.rationale: No exact purchase, cancellation or return date is stated.

story: I ordered a laptop backpack on the Flipkart app. When the parcel arrived on July 4, 2022 it was empty: no backpack, no bill and no warranty card. I reported it in the Flipkart app straight away and asked for a refund. Flipkart asked for my ID and my consent to use my information, and I gave both. My refund request has still been rejected three times without any explanation.

expected.rationale: No exact purchase, cancellation or return date is stated (the delivery date is not one of the decision dates).

story: On 20.06.2021 I ordered a Caran D'Ache ball pen for ₹1,611 on Flipkart, supplied by the seller William Penn. It was delivered on 26.06.2021 in a different colour from the one I ordered, so I asked for a replacement. The first replacement request was cancelled on 30.06.2021. A second replacement was accepted, but the pen delivered on 06.07.2021 again differed in colour and refill from my order. The seller now says it issued me a refund on July 9, 2021, and the refund is in dispute.

expected.rationale: Whether support was contacted about the refund, and whether the refund was credited, is not stated clearly enough for R3/R5.

story: On 14 March 2024 I bought hair gummies for ₹799 on Amazon from the seller Mosaic Wellness. They were delivered on 17 March 2024 and I took one a day for six days, during which I had stomach pain, vomiting and dizziness. Then I noticed on the pack that the product had already expired in February 2024. I contacted Amazon on 23 March 2024 asking to return it for a refund, but they rejected the request saying the item is non-returnable and outside the return window.

expected.rationale: Refund denied, exact purchase and return-request dates, support contacted, grievance officer not mentioned.

story: I ordered a Fujifilm X-T5 mirrorless camera worth Rs. 1,43,000 through Amazon from the seller Clicktech Retail. It was delivered on 10-02-2025, but the box contained a different model, an X-T50, and the package had two conflicting labels. I told them immediately. They agreed to take it back and refund me, the camera was collected from my home, and the seller received it on 20-02-2025. They still refused to refund Rs. 1,43,000. Customer support told me an investigation had cleared them and claimed I had returned the wrong product. On 21-02-2025 Amazon emailed me that the returned item was used and damaged. I sent photographs of the conflicting labels, but the refund request was rejected without a valid reason.

expected.rationale: Refund denied, exact return date, support contacted, grievance officer not mentioned.

story: I bought a Samsung Galaxy Book 2 Pro 360 laptop worth ₹1,29,990 on Amazon on May 29, 2023. It was delivered on June 2, 2023, but when I opened the sealed package the laptop was missing and the box held electronic waste. I raised a grievance with Amazon on June 12, 2023. Amazon denied my claim, saying the laptop was sold by a third-party seller, Appario Retail, and that its records show it was delivered. Despite repeated efforts I have received neither the laptop nor a refund.

expected.rationale: "Raised a grievance with Amazon" does not say whether this was ordinary support or the grievance officer, which decides between R5 and R6/R7.

story: I ordered black flared high-rise jeans from Myntra on 22 December 2024 for ₹495. What arrived on 28 December, sent by Navya Hosiery, was a different brand of jeans. My refund/exchange request dated 4 January 2025 was rejected without any valid reason. I contacted Myntra customer care and sent a legal notice on 17 February 2025, but nothing has been done.

expected.rationale: Refund denied, exact purchase and return-request dates, customer care contacted, grievance officer not mentioned (a legal notice is not the grievance officer).

story: I bought a Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 laptop for Rs. 28,990 on the PayTM Mall app on 17.06.2021. The delivery date was 24.06.2021 but the parcel came on 03.07.2021, and when it was opened in front of the delivery person it held a T-shirt with a Rs. 349 price tag instead of the laptop. The issue was raised with PayTM customer care with photographs. The company acknowledged it and promised refund initiation and a pickup on 10.07.2021, but the return request was then cancelled without explanation. I tried many times through PayTM's grievance redressal system, escalated to the National Consumer Helpline on 15.07.2021, visited the PayTM office in Chennai, and sent a legal notice dated 17.09.2021, which was ignored.

expected.rationale: The grievance route was attempted and is unresolved, but the verified corpus holds no accepted Consumer Commission route provision, so R6 cannot fire.

story: I ordered an HP Pavilion laptop on Amazon on December 26, 2023 and paid Rs 61,990. It was delivered on December 27, 2023, but it was an obsolete IBM ThinkPad, not what I ordered. I contacted customer care immediately; they asked me to photograph the product and upload the photos, which I did. The item was picked up on January 1, 2024, but no refund came. On January 7, 2024 I got a message that the return was lost in transit. On January 19, 2024 Amazon emailed that it cannot refund me because the returned item is different from what I ordered and my number of refunds exceeds expectations under its Use Policy. I replied that I returned it because it was different from what I ordered.

expected.rationale: Refund denied, exact purchase and pickup dates, support contacted, grievance officer not mentioned.

story: I ordered WeCool earbuds from VLE Bazaar, an online marketplace, on April 14, 2025 and paid ₹359. When the package was delivered on April 30, 2025 it contained boAt earbuds instead. I contacted the platform immediately and they asked me to email photographs of the wrong product. I sent them and followed up repeatedly, but got no response, and the wrong product was never taken back.

expected.rationale: The refund status is not stated.
